# securitls_validate_attachment (Action)

Validate a certificate attachment on a SecuriTLS device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "securitls_validate_attachment" "web01_cert" {
  config {
    device_id = securitls_device.web01.id
    cert_id   = securitls_certificate.leaf.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cert_id` (String) Certificate ID attached to the device.
- `device_id` (String) SecuriTLS device ID.
